MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Christmas Voices was the one clear match because Christmas music appears repeatedly in my history, so it gave me a specific reason to try it.",
    "The vocal emphasis of Christmas Voices also fit what appealed to me about my recent holiday listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Alabama and Randy Travis collections offered country hits, but my recent choices gave me no reason to seek country music now.",
    "A concert album, a musical soundtrack, and general greatest hits did not carry the holiday connection that made Christmas Voices appealing.",
    "Titles such as The Ultimate Collection, 16 Most Requested Songs, and Storm left me unsure whether the music matched my interests, so I would skip them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seemed to assume that interest in holiday vocals would extend to a broad range of singers and familiar songs.",
    "Several recommendations treated a hits collection or concert recording as enough of a connection, while I needed a more specific reason to listen."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas album choices were a stronger reason for interest than a loose connection to vocal music.",
    "Those holiday choices happened close together, followed much later by The New Old Fashioned, so they do not establish that I am always looking for Christmas music.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear connection to my interests; a potentially related title alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "Christmas Voices captured a specific interest, but most of the list stretched that interest into broader listening preferences I had not shown."
}
